q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?
n: This is Alejandro Aravena, the 2016 laureate. He is Chilean, known for ELEMENTAL's incremental "half a good house" social housing, such as Quinta Monroy in Iquique.

q: Which Pritzker-winning partnership is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker-winning partnership is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?

q: Which Pritzker Prize laureate is shown in the photo?
